program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((crop (crop-to-content g))
         (top (quotient (- (rows g) (rows crop)) 2))
         (left (quotient (- (cols g) (cols crop)) 2)))
    (for*/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
               ([r (in-range (rows crop))]
                [c (in-range (cols crop))])
      (set-cell out (+ top r) (+ left c) (at crop r c)))))
